summary:
Four years after his move to Ottawa, it was more or less an open secret in the league that Shane Hollander was probably not a straight man. And yet, Shane Hollander was captain of an MLH team that was now a playoff contender. Shane Hollander had not lost his career or his brand deals or his reputation. Shane Hollander had, despite all odds, survived.
And if a gay hockey player had managed to survive the MLH, surely all was not lost for the bisexual player who followed in his wake.
OR
What if a devastating tragedy had veered the story that we all know so well onto a different course?
One way or another, it always comes to a head at The Cottage.
